title: Refactor: data-driven mountains, inert scene layer, centralized canvas constants
description: Pre-feature refactor of how-tall-is-mount-everest (single 50,000px scrollable canvas, kept as-is). Fixes three structural problems: (1) adding a mountain takes 5 coordinated edits that drift out of sync; (2) the mountain layer is only loosely inert; (3) canvas dimensions are duplicated magic numbers across Metronome.tsx and index.css. Source: REFACTOR_PLAN.md. Outcome: adding a mountain becomes drop-SVG + one data row; one inert decorative scene layer; canvas height defined once in TypeScript. Children: canvas-constants (P3), data-driven-mountains (P1), scene-layer (P2), remove-dead-code (P4), verification.

title: Centralize canvas constants (scene.ts, Metronome, main.tsx, index.css)
description: Section 3. FILES: create src/config/scene.ts exporting PAGE_HEIGHT=50000, MAP_HEIGHT=6800, SUMMIT_OFFSET=2500, MOUNTAIN_SPACING=2500; src/components/Metronome/Metronome.tsx (import these instead of literal 50000/6800/2500, keep 350 and 100 scroll-edge thresholds as named locals, wrap scroll handler body in a requestAnimationFrame ticking guard); src/main.tsx (on boot inject --page-height and --half-page-height CSS vars from PAGE_HEIGHT); src/index.css (remove hardcoded --page-height/--half-page-height from :root, leave rest intact). index.html keeps using var(--page-height), no change. ACCEPTANCE: canvas height defined once in TS; Metronome reads constants from scene.ts; CSS vars injected at runtime; scroll handler rAF-throttled; scroll/meter behaviour identical. Foundational: no blockers; blocks data-driven-mountains.

title: Data-driven mountain system (eliminate the 5-edit gotcha)
description: Section 1. Make mountainsInfo.ts the single source of truth and derive everything else. FILES: src/components/Mountains/mountainsInfo.ts (discover SVGs via import.meta.glob of ../../assets/mountains/*.svg with eager true, query ?url, import default; build filename->URL lookup; reshape data rows to MountainConfig keyed by asset filename; throw a clear error on a missing asset); src/components/Mountains/Mountains.tsx (remove the MountainID union, export MountainConfig in PascalCase, derive top = SUMMIT_OFFSET + index*MOUNTAIN_SPACING and zIndex = index+1, pass resolved src/top/zIndex to Mountain); src/components/Mountains/Mountain.tsx (delete the mountainVariants map, apply position/image via inline style top/zIndex/backgroundImage, keep static size and bg-cover classes); tailwind.config.js (remove the 25 bg-mountain-N entries, keep clouds, grids, floor-to-sky gradients). ACCEPTANCE: adding a mountain = drop N-NAME.svg in assets + add one data row; MountainID and mountainVariants are gone; all 25 SVGs render at even index-derived spacing. Imports SUMMIT_OFFSET/MOUNTAIN_SPACING from scene.ts so it depends on canvas-constants. Blocks scene-layer.

title: Non-interactive scene layer (lock it down robustly)
description: Section 2. Introduce one decorative wrapper around the mountains so the whole scene is provably inert and sits behind future interactive UI. FILES: src/components/Mountains/Mountains.tsx (or a thin new Scene wrapper rendered in App.tsx) wrapping the mapped mountains in a div with aria-hidden and classes "absolute top-0 left-0 w-full h-full pointer-events-none select-none" (absolute h-full keeps it out of normal flow and gives absolutely-positioned mountains an explicit positioned ancestor); src/components/Mountains/Mountain.tsx (add draggable=false as belt-and-suspenders against native drag ghosts); keep Metronome at z-99 outside/above this layer as the interactive UI layer. ACCEPTANCE: mountains cannot be dragged, drag-ghosted, or text-selected; decorative layer sits below interactive UI. Wraps the mapped mountains, so it depends on data-driven-mountains.

title: Remove dead / stub code
description:
Section 4. Disposition: stub cleanly, do not delete scaffolding. FILES: src/components/Animations/Stars.tsx, Ashes.tsx, Clouds.tsx and src/components/Illustrations/Illustrations.tsx (return null instead of debug text like
Clouds
so they inject nothing into the DOM, but keep the files since the names map to intended future effects); src/components/Metronome/Metronome.tsx (remove the six leftover empty
children inside the text ref); src/App.tsx (remove the commented-out Dividers import/usage; Dividers.tsx file can stay). ACCEPTANCE: no placeholder debug text in the DOM; stub components render null; leftover empty divs gone. INDEPENDENT: no blockers, can run in parallel.

title: Verification (build, lint, browser checks)
description: Final verification of the whole refactor. STEPS: npm run build must pass (validates the glob typing, MountainConfig reshape, and removal of MountainID/mountainVariants); npm run lint clean; npm run dev and in the browser: all 25 mountain SVGs render (intentionally break one filename to confirm the missing-asset error fires), scrolling updates the Metronome meter and the active toggle behaves at top/bottom edges, mountains cannot be drag-selected or drag-ghosted and labels cannot be highlighted, no console errors, vertical spacing is even. SANITY: add a throwaway 26th SVG + one data row, confirm it appears at the next position with no other edits, then revert. Depends on all four sections.
